newsitem.title: USA: DeVry seeks increase in authorized shares.
newsitem.headline: DeVry seeks increase in authorized shares.

text.p: DeVry Inc said in a proxy for its November 19 annual shareholder meeting that it seeks approval to increase the number of authorized shares to 75 million from 20 million.
At September 20, it said, 16.6 million shares were outstanding and 775,745 shares were reserved for isuance under the company's restated stock option plan.

DeVry, which provides career-oriented higher education programs, said it has no plans to use the added shares. It said their availability would enhance its flexibility in connection with possible future stock dividends, splits or financings.
